name: mbongo
description: Monorepo for mbongo project - AI Agent Configuration with Spec-Driven Development and Clean Code

scripts.prisma:migrate: cd apps/web && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:push: cd apps/web && npx prisma db push
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.quality:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push
